고소득 국가들의 2023년 총인구를 계산해 보겠습니다. 

고소득 국가들: 
Australia, Austria, Bahamas, Bahrain, Barbados, Belgium, Brunei Darussalam, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hong Kong SAR, China, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, South Korea, Kuwait, Latvia, Luxembourg, Macao SAR, China, Malta, Netherlands, New Caledonia, New Zealand, Norway, Oman, Poland, Portugal, Puerto Rico (US), Qatar, Romania, Russian Federation, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Slovak Republic, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States, Uruguay

총인구: 
26659922 + 9131761 + 399440 + 1577059 + 282336 + 11779946 + 458949 + 6446596 + 40049088 + 19658835 + 3859686 + 1344976 + 10864042 + 5946952 + 1370286 + 5583911 + 68372286 + 9849000 + 58984216 + 124516650 + 51712619 + 4853420 + 1883710 + 666430 + 678800 + 2871585 + 10578174 + 3203794 + 2656032 + 19061062 + 143826130 + 8888822 + 10536632 + 17877117 + 5200000 + 8897222 + 3388081 = 1244383471

고소득 국가의 수(n): 44

표본표준편차(s) = √[(Σ(xi - μ)²) / (n - 1)]

여기서 xi는 각 국가의 총인구, μ는 평균 총인구입니다.

μ = 1244383471 / 44 = 28299505.02

Σ(xi - μ)² = (26659922 - 28299505.02)² + (9131761 - 28299505.02)² + ... + (3388081 - 28299505.02)² = 1014681391644221

s = √[(1014681391644221) / (44 - 1)] = √(1014681391644221 / 43) = √23627967.42 ≈ 4857.11

최종값: 4857.11 명
